plan: My private value is $20. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. Other bidders are rational and likely doing the same. I'll bid close to my true value to maximize potential profit. If I bid exactly $20, I ensure I only win if my value justifies the price, and I'll only pay the second-highest bid. This strategy balances risk and potential gain.
